line.name: Oliva Serie G Maduro
line.description: A full parallel Maduro-wrapper line to the site's existing Serie G entry, not a wrapper flag on the same 5 vitolas - its vitola lineup is genuinely different (7 vitolas here vs. 5 in the standard line, with some names/sizes not overlapping 1:1).
line.wrapper: Connecticut Broadleaf (per halfwheel and Cigar Aficionado spec data)
line.notes: Some retailer/manufacturer marketing copy (olivacigar.com, cigarsinternational.com) describes the wrapper as Mexican or a blended 'Connecticut Broadleaf Mexican San Andres' descriptor - treated as loose marketing language rather than a factual contradiction; Connecticut Broadleaf is used here per the more rigorous halfwheel/Cigar Aficionado spec sheets.

vitolas.name: Torpedo
vitolas.size: 6 x 52 (some retailers list 6.5 x 52 - not resolved)

research_notes: Only 'Maduro' is confirmed by direct Mac photo evidence (filename didn't specify a vitola); the full 7-vitola lineup is from independent research since Serie G Maduro is a distinct, well-documented product. Worth double-checking the site's plain 'Serie G' vitola list too - Serie G Maduro's lineup doesn't map 1:1 to it (Torpedo and Presidente appear only in Maduro; Special Corona/Toro from the standard line don't have obvious Maduro equivalents), suggesting the two lines' compositions may have diverged over time rather than being a clean wrapper-only split.
